model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for Mistralv0.2-Base fine-tuned on various specialties. The horizontal axis represents the specialties, which are categorized into Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, and are labeled in a categorical scale. The vertical axis represents the negative log probability, labeled with a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Each specialty category contains a group of bars, with each bar representing a different fine-tuning specialty, labeled and colored according to the legend: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order and vary in height, with approximate values ranging from -26.5 to -22.5; for example, the tallest bar in the Cardio category has a value of around -22.5, while the shortest bar has a value of around -26. The bars are visually arranged in a grouped format, allowing for comparison across fine-tuning specialties within each per-specialty term category. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
